description.en:
The big Hörmann barn with the GEA feeding robot, converted for pigs.
Fill the robot's four hoppers and the barn is fed from them every hour: - Silo outside: base feed (corn or sorghum), 50% - Grain bin: grains (wheat or barley), 25% - Protein bin: protein (soybeans, canola or sunflowers), 20% - Root crop bin: root crops (potatoes or sugar beet), 5% Each hopper takes every crop of its group, including the ones your map adds, and nothing else. Each group feeds its own share, so an empty hopper only stops that part of the diet.
Bought-in Pig Food is tipped straight into the feed alley inside the barn, like TMR in the cow barn. The robot only mixes crops. Loose pig crops can go into the feed alley too.
Manure is stored in the barn and loads at the slurry point. A manure heap nearby adds storage.
Straw bales can be dropped in the feed alley; they go into the straw storage. The barn's info box shows how long each hopper and the straw last, and you get a warning when one runs low (under a month left) or empty.
Price: 800,000 Upkeep: 700 / day Pigs: up to 1500 Food: 800,000 l Straw: 1,000,000 l Liquid manure: 1,500,000 l Manure: 1,200,000 l Protein bin: 400,000 l Root crop bin: 120,000 l Grain bin: 500,000 l Base feed silo: 1,000,000 l Robot mixer: 30,000 l Automatic water supply
